title: Companies (Amendment) Act
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE COMPANIES ACT, NO. 07 OF 2007

edition.caveat: read from the Government Printer PDF

target.named_target: the Companies Act, No. 07 of 2007 (hereinafter referred to as the “principal enactment”)

body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Companies (Amendment) Short title.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Companies (Amendment) Short title.

body.heading: Amendment of section 5 of Act, No. 07 of 2007.
body.raw_text: 2. Section 5 of the Companies Act, No. 07 of 2007 (hereinafter referred to as the “principal enactment”) is hereby amended in subsection (1) by the repeal of paragraphs (b) and (c) thereof and the substitution therefor, of the following:- “(b) assign a unique number to that company as its company number; (c) issue a certificate of incorporation in the prescribed form to the applicant company; and (d) notify the general public, within sixty working days of the incorporation of a company, by a notice published in a daily newspaper which has circulation in Sinhala, English and Tamil languages which shall specify – (i) name of the company; (ii) the company registration number; and (iii) the address of the registered office of the company.”. 2 Companies (Amendment)

body.heading: Amendment of section 9 of the principal enactment.
body.raw_text: 3. Section 9 of the principal enactment is hereby amended as follows:- (1) by the repeal of subsection (1) thereof; and (2) in subsection (3) thereof, by the substitution for the words “subsection (1) or (2)” of the words, “subsection (2)”.
body.text: Section 9 of the principal enactment is hereby amended as follows:- (1) by the repeal of subsection (1) thereof; and (2) in subsection (3) thereof, by the substitution for the words “subsection (1) or (2)” of the words, “subsection (2)”.

body.heading: Amendment of section 10 of the principal enactment.
body.raw_text: 4. Section 10 of the principal enactment is hereby amended by the repeal of paragraph (b) of subsection (1) thereof, and the substitution therefor, of the following paragraph:- “(b) a request is made to the Registrar to do so within three months of public notice of the name being given under section 5 (1) (d) and section 9 (2) by another company or by a registered overseas company, where – (i) the name of the first mentioned company is so similar to the name of the requesting company that it is likely to cause confusion; and (ii) the requesting company was registered with its current name before the first mentioned company was registered with the name objected to; or”.

body.heading: Sinhala text to prevail in case of and inconsistency.
body.raw_text: 5. In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail. Companies (Amendment) 3
